method: Read-only lexical counting of the frozen before/after patch sides; no model outputs, inference, training, fitted classifier or corpus edits. Verified all48before/after reconstruction hashes against the existing fixture audits.

feature_definitions.upstream_reference_occurrences: Exact occurrences of firwood/trie in training notice text and dawnline/leaf-cache in transfer notice text; each occurrence here is an upstream credit line. Counts are over a single patch side, excluding removed lines from the after side.
feature_definitions.raw_patch: A secondary count over the Surrounding diff patch, including removed/context/added lines once; repeated Changed lines listings are excluded.

conclusion: The24new training quartet labels are perfectly separated by remaining protection-looking occurrence presence. The same three count features are equal within every opposite-label fresh-transfer pair.

raw_patch_count.rule: Predict concern iff the sum of the same raw-patch occurrence counts is1.

equal_feature_collision.argument: Each of the12semantic pairs has identical count inputs and opposite labels. A deterministic count-only decision gives both members the same label, so one member of each pair is correct and none of the pairs is fully correct.

interpretation: The diff-shape revision removes the earlier deletion-versus-replacement label cue. In these24training rows it simultaneously makes presence of one retained guard/sort/upstream reference a perfect label cue.

Transfer varies the protected operand, permission bit, selected bound, output dataflow or notice component while preserving the audited counts. Its frozen semantic witnesses distinguish effective from ineffective retained lookalikes.

If new training-quartet scores improve while transfer scores do not, the simple remaining presence/count cue is a concrete alternative explanation to a limitation in last-MLP representations. The measured model outputs and family-level contrasts can then determine the next control.

The count result covers the specified three occurrence features and the24new quartet rows. The full52review training corpus also retains14other pairs, including six pairs with identical full diffs and differing rules; the24-row perfect label rule is not a result for all52reviews.

The calculated12/24transfer ceiling concerns decisions using only these counts, even with family and shape supplied. Identifier choice, control/dataflow, component scope and other textual features are outside that restricted input.

families.semantic_difference: Both labels retain one NULL-checking if. Harmful checks the always-non-NULL borrowed sentinel; clean checks the newly allocated fresh pointer before its dereference.
Both labels retain one zero-comparison if. Harmful checks units; clean checks lanes, the denominator used by available/lanes.
Both labels retain one rights-checking if. Harmful checks READ; clean checks EDIT, the right required for commit_blob.
Both labels retain one bound-checking if and both bound definitions. Harmful selects limit.narrow based on uint32_t; clean selects limit.wide based on the actual uint64_t element.
Both labels retain one sort call creating sortedView. Harmful serializes view; clean serializes sortedView, so the dataflow to output determines whether that sort protects ordering.
Both labels retain two identical upstream source/license lines. Harmful scopes both to leaf_scan.c; clean scopes one to the retained leaf_store.c implementation whose original credit was removed.
